authentication: api_key_registry: X-API-Key compared in constant time against a registry of grants, each bound to one tenant with a subject and roles
execution: generated tests run only through the trust model, in a copy of the project; the local executor is process hygiene, not a sandbox; the container executor (--executor container) runs them in an OCI container with restrictions verified per run

identity.subject_source: settings.api_keys[key].subject (default: a digest of the key)

multi_tenant.principal_tenant_binding: enforced: the tenant path parameter must equal the tenant bound to the presented API key, otherwise 403
storage_isolation: tenant_id column on every entity and a tenant filter on every repository query
composite foreign keys (tenant_id, id) between tenant tables: a row cannot reference another tenant's row

not_claimed: network or filesystem isolation of executed tests under the local executor (the container executor provides both, verified per run and recorded in verification.tests.run.environment)

protection against code the generated tests execute under the local executor (process hygiene, not a sandbox); under the container executor, protection against vulnerabilities of the container runtime or the kernel
OAuth2 authorization flows (code, PKCE, device), consent, token issuance, refresh tokens or an authorization server (only externally issued tokens are validated)
public resources inside an authenticated API
authorization proven by the name of a dependency (the auditor counts a policy only where its code shows the decision)

persistence.infrastructure_failure: database unreachable is answered 503 (problem+json), distinct from 401/403/404
persistence.migrations: alembic: generated environment and initial migration; tables are created only by `alembic upgrade head`

resource_authorization: not generated (spec.security.authorization = 'resource' is a pending decision; schema 1.2 declares the policy object)
